description:
Lezhin's 'Tied to You' anthology consist of 8 short stories, with the theme being dark & tied to someone. 

**Collection of Stories:**  
1. [The Abyss](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/ydmz4ar) by Eeej  
2. [Placebo](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/kcp3kd8) by Cuke Soap  
3. [Adam's Rib](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/qas7z2e) by Jinmi  
4. [Hit Me!](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/zeuzruv) by Wook  
5. [The Man Next Door Is a Vampire](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/dzfhx1a) by Park Minam  
6. [Tied Up](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/7hsx4bc) by Mono  
7. [Wonna Do It?!](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/j9spech) by Cho Sangduck  
8. [Bestializarse](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/pbl19hl) (Beast) by 4U

[Official Webtoons](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/page/relay_short)  
[Official English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/page/cilf2_sat)
